setups.orientation_and_workholding: Pins facing +Z. Raw block 170 x 85 x 24 (Al 6061) in a fixture; in MillLab a vise with the whole block height above the jaws.
setups.work_zero: G54 X0 Y0 at the front-left top corner, Z0 = block top = pin tops. Large boss axis X40 Y40, keyway towards +Y, second boss on +X at X40+d (d unknown).

operations.name: Face the whole block to Z-4 around the pin ring (boss top faces)
operations.strategy: roughing/facing, single level, zigzag + circular passes
operations.depth_of_cut: 4.0 mm axial (Z0 to Z-4); stepover max 6.75 mm

operations.name: Mill bore D30 through
operations.strategy: centre plunge + circular interpolation rough (D29.6), finish pass D30 at full depth
operations.depth_of_cut: 2.0 mm per level, Z-4 to Z-24.5; finish 0.2 mm radial

operations.name: Mill six pins D3.5 x 4 and clear the pin ring
operations.strategy: two climb loops per pin per level (radius 10 and 4.75 about the pin axis)
operations.depth_of_cut: 2.0 mm per level, 2 levels to Z-4

operations.name: Mill keyway width 8, bottom 18 from axis, through
operations.strategy: rectangular climb loop per level, entry in the bore void
operations.depth_of_cut: 2.0 mm per level, Z-4 to Z-24.5

operations.name: Keyway corners sharp per drawing (broaching/slotting, not on this machine)
operations.tool: none in magazine (broach or slotting tool)

operations.name: Rough outside both bosses from Z-4 to arm top Z-9
Rough outside the part outline and the window from Z-9 to Z-19 (arm level)
Mill bore D20 through
operations.strategy: as OP20 (tool-centre circle R4.8 rough / R5 finish)
operations.depth_of_cut: 2.0 mm per level, Z-4 to Z-24.5

operations.name: Finish boss walls (Z-4 to Z-19), arm edges and window with R8 corners
operations.depth_of_cut: max 2.0 mm per level, 0.3 mm radial

operations.name: R2 fillets, arm top faces to boss walls; finish arm top face Z-9
operations.strategy: 2.5D contour with bull-nose corner R2 along the boss walls

setups.orientation_and_workholding: Part turned over about the Y axis (X -> 170 - X), held in a dedicated support fixture protecting the S1 features. MillLab simulates from a raw block.
setups.work_zero: G54 front-left corner after flipping; Z0 = bottom faces of the bosses. Large boss axis X130 Y40; small boss at X130-d.

operations.name: Clear outside both bosses Z0 to Z-5 (arm underside), finish lower boss walls
R2 fillets, arm bottom faces to boss walls
Break sharp edges, remove burrs
operations.tool: manual (T09 chamfer mill has no approved cutting data)

assumptions: Z0 (block top, nothing faced) = pin tops, because pin height 4 + boss height 20 = stock height 24.
Pins are integral to the part: 6 pins equally spaced at 30 + k*60 deg on radius 23, one on +Y (keyway side).
B-B dimension 23 = boss axis to pin centre; 18 = boss axis to keyway bottom.
Arms are centred in the boss height (S1 Z-9 to Z-19). Used only to describe the blocked operations.

R115 is internally tangent and R60 externally tangent to both bosses. If confirmed, the arc centres relative to the large boss axis, with d = boss centre distance, are: C115 x = (d^2 - 1611)/(2d), y = -sqrt(7225 - x^2); C60 x = (d^2 + 1539)/(2d), y = -sqrt(8100 - x^2). Window edges are R107 about C115 and R68 about C60, closed by the D60/D42 walls with R8 blends.
No value for d is assumed. All d-dependent NC is withheld rather than guessed.
T02 and T03 are centre-cutting, so OP20 plunges at the bore centre.
Through features are cut to Z-24.5 (0.5 mm breakthrough). The real fixture needs relief under both bores and the keyway.
Tool-centre programming with G40 (no G41/G42). Offsets use the approved radii T02 R5 and T03 R3.
No coolant is programmed because coolant is not in the approved data.
MillLab accepts full circles (G02/G03, same start and end point, I/J centre).
Not used: T01 and T12 (no cutting data), T04-T07, T09 and T11 (no cutting data), T08 (inconsistent row).
The individual op files assume the preceding ops of the same setup are done. For MillLab (raw block start), run setup_01_complete.nc.
